request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real food, glass, ceramic and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Ana: about thirty, long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top. Keep her face, hair and clothes exactly. Create a NEW photograph at midday: Ana sits at a table by a sunny window and EATS salad: she lifts a fork with green lettuce to her open mouth from a white bowl of mixed green salad in front of her. Bright midday sunlight comes through the window. She is seen from the waist up; her face, the fork and the bowl are sharp. Exactly one person; only the salad bowl is on the table. No letters, words, numbers, logos, labels or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
